reading_note: The teaching describes three modes of divine compassion within the Lord's own economy toward the goods and truths that have descended into the natural mind and become commingled with falsity from evil. The arc moves through three "grievings": first the matrix from which spiritual life is born, then the divine truth itself in human form, and (beginning) a third — each suffers with the captive remainders, hearing their cry, registering their bondage, and inclining the heart of the Divine toward their deliverance. The single arc is divine pity flowing down through discrete degrees toward what is held fast in the hells of the natural.
